svg.title: From building a routine to substitute teachers
svg.desc: The Admin first sets shifts, period times and rules. Then they arrange each section's routine, send it for review and publish it. In review, teachers see only their own periods; after publishing, everyone sees it. If a teacher is absent, the Admin records a substitute teacher for that day only, and the weekly routine does not change.
